name: Mirage
description: A living glass theme: the whole UI takes on the colours of the album art, the cover drifts behind the panels, the background pulses on the beat – plus an immersive mode with synced lyrics, a visualizer and full controls.

name: Mirage App
description: Companion page for the Mirage theme: colour schemes in one click, your week in colours, quick actions (immersive mode, share cards), Mirage Overlay status and the one-click repair after Spotify updates.
